_note: Each MCP server's tools/list, as data. rote compile grounds tool arguments in it for a server it cannot list live; a live tools/list wins. The compile bench's fixture servers serve exactly these tools.

tools.name: read_file_content
tools.description: Read a Google Drive file by id and return its content as text. A spreadsheet comes back as CSV of the named tab, or of its first tab when none is named.

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Search Gmail with a Gmail query string and return the matching threads, newest first, each with its id, subject, sender, date and a snippet of the latest message.
